_comment: Read-only MCP access to nephilim's Neo4j graph, for the operator and Claude Code.
NOT for gwen — see scripts/mcp/graph_server.py's docstring for why her path stays in-process.
No credentials here on purpose. The server resolves Neo4j settings through
pydantic-settings, which reads .env relative to the working directory, so cwd is
the whole configuration and this file can be committed without carrying a secret.
Relative paths match the ecosystem's other MCP server (btc_price_tracker/.mcp.json),
with .venv/ rather than venv/ because that is nephilim's layout.
To enable the raw-Cypher escape hatch for your own exploration, add:
It is absent by default: it costs context in every client's tool list, and the ten
typed tools are the real read-only boundary. When enabled it still rejects write
clauses AND runs inside a transaction that is always rolled back.
